question: In Badminton, the length and width of the doubles court shall be of ______________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**13.40 m × 6.10 m**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• 13.40 m × 6.10m is the official dimension for badminton doubles court.
 
• The length of the court is 13.40 meters, and the width is 6.10 meters.
 
• These dimensions are set by the Badminton World Federation (BWF) and are followed in all official tournaments.
 
• The court has a center line that divides it into two equal halves, and there are service boxes marked on both sides.
 
• The net is placed in the center, and its height is 1.55 meters at the edges and 1.524 meters in the center.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Badminton Overview:**

 
• Sport Type: Racquet sport played using racquets to hit a shuttlecock across a net.
 
• Team Members: Can be played as singles (one player per side) or doubles (two players per side).
 
• Equipment: Shuttlecock and racquet.
 
• Playing Area: Played on a rectangular indoor court.
 
• Objective: Points are scored by hitting the shuttlecock with the racquet and making it land within the opponent's half of the court.
 
• Shuttlecock: A feathered or plastic projectile that decelerates rapidly due to its design.
 
• Origin: Developed in British India from the earlier game of battledore and shuttlecock. Became popular in Asia, especially in China.
 
• Olympic Debut: Introduced in the Summer Olympics in 1992 with events like men's singles, women's singles, men's doubles, and women's doubles. Mixed doubles was added later.
 
• Physical Demands: Requires aerobic stamina, agility, strength, speed, and precision. It's also a technical sport demanding good motor coordination.

**Court Dimensions:**

 
• Full Width: 6.1 metres (20 feet) for doubles and 5.18 metres (17.0 feet) for singles.
 
• Full Length: 13.4 metres (44 feet).
 
• Net Height: 1.55 metres (5 feet 1 inch) at the edges and 1.524 metres (5.00 feet) in the center.
